releaseNotes:
- Default .gitignore now ignores only the root /vendor/ folder, not nested paths like public/vendor
- .gitignore is created once and is not rewritten when saving Settings or switching projects
- Settings: choose whether Deploy opens files docked or in a float window (all projects)
- Settings: persist terminal font size and text color (also from the terminal toolbar)
